## Download
Download **OpenCheck.zip** below, unzip it, and run `OpenCheck.exe`. Keep the other files next to it.

This page is the only official download. If you got OpenCheck anywhere else, delete it and download it here.

OpenCheck never asks you to turn off your antivirus or add an exclusion. If a copy asks you to, it's fake.
